entries.title: Baby Lapsit Storytime and Stay & Play
entries.description: nbsp;Baby Lapsit invites newborns, infants, babies, and their caregivers to learn together and strengthen their relationship with each other through stories, songs, bounces, tickles, rhymes, books, and play.After storytime concludes, we invite you to Stay Play.

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: Participating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading, and learning.

entries.title: Book Bugs Club for 2nd and 3rd Graders
entries.description: At our book club meeting we will discuss the book and enjoy a fun craft or activity.nbsp;Please pick up a copy of the booknbsp;at the Children's Desknbsp;at Los Altos Library or at Woodlandnbsp;Library for check out.
entries.priorTitleZh: 2、3 年级 Book Bugs 读书俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 喜欢读书的孩子可以与同伴聊聊读过的书。

entries.title: Mindful Movement: Yoga for Kids
entries.description: Through mindful movement, stretching, and breathing, children will be able to explore the joy of wellness.nbsp;For children ages 6-10.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子通过正念活动、伸展和呼吸，体验身心健康的乐趣。

entries.title: Neurosphere: Neuroscience and More! Grades 3-8
entries.description: This session willnbsp;dive into the basics of brain function, fun activities to test your brainpower, and an introduction to future career opportunities.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 了解大脑工作的基础知识，参与测试脑力的趣味活动，并认识未来的职业机会。

entries.title: Inclusive Sensory Movement & Regulation Workshop~  REGULACION SENSORIAL CON MUSICA
entries.description: In collaboration with JMM Dance Co., Gilroy Library is hosting monthly Inclusive Sensory Movement and Regulation workshops every third Sunday for the rest of 2026.nbsp;\nThese workshops will introduce families to sensory regulation through gentle, structurednbsp;movement activities grounded in rhythm, body awareness, and emotional safety.
entries.priorTitleZh: 包容性感官律动与调节工作坊
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 由受训的 JMM Dance Co. 带领者主持，孩子可按自己的舒适程度参与：活动、观看或休息都可以。

entries.title: Sunday CrafterNoon
entries.description:
Adults, teens, and kids -- join us for an afternoon of relaxed crafting on the third Sunday of the month.
Suppliesnbsp;are provided for you to explore a surprise art activity.
This craft is self-directed; children must come with their responsible adult crafting-buddy.
The room closes at 3:30 PM, so please give yourself enough time to finish your craft.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子在负责照看的成人陪伴下自行完成手工。
